description: This file defines internal interfaces related to consistent ring management within the Orleans.Runtime.ConsistentRing namespace, including IConsistentRingProvider for managing ring responsibility ranges and ring change subscriptions, as well as IRingRangeListener for receiving range change notifications.

classes.name: IConsistentRingProvider
classes.description: Interface for a provider managing the consistent hashing ring, including methods to get the current range, subscribe/unsubscribe to range change events, and determine the primary target silo for a key.

classes.name: IRingRangeListener
classes.description: Interface for objects that listen to range change notifications, defining a method to handle range change events.

methods.name: GetMyRange
methods.description: Retrieves the responsibility range of the current silo.

methods.name: SubscribeToRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to receive range change notifications.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from receiving range change notifications.

methods.name: GetPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Determines which silo is responsible for the given key based on consistent hashing.

methods.name: RangeChangeNotification
methods.description: Callback for notifying about range changes, including the old range, new range, and whether the range has increased.
